sloka: ते वीक्षमाणा वृक्षाम् च पुष्प भार अवलम्बिनः ।प्रसन्न अंबुवहाः चैव सरितः सागरम् गमाः ॥४-१३-५॥
transliteration: te vīkṣamāṇā vṛkṣām ca puṣpa bhāra avalambinaḥ ।prasanna aṁbuvahāḥ caiva saritaḥ sāgaram gamāḥ ॥4-13-5॥

translations.english: They saw (on the way) trees bent down with the load of flowers, and rivers with pure water flowing into the sea.
